rows.en: ...the Capture Cube won't be able to block all of it.
I see...
In other words, there won't be a next time. Make sure you silence that particle cannon!!
This is terrible!! The lab equipment got wrecked by that bombardment just now!!
Rider 2 is doing emergency repairs right now, but...
If they fire on us one more time, the base will be wiped out!!
That bombardment just now took out the Capture Cube. It's unusable...
That leaves us no way to block their fire from our end... You're our only lifeline.
Yeah! Leave it to us!! We won't let them fire ever again!!
Heh, full of fight as always, Zero. ...By the way, where's Seravee?
Uh, Seravee's...
He went into the Terminal Unit, didn't he?
Oh, right. That's it.
Isn't he defenseless while he's accessing it? What are you doing? Hurry back to him.
A place giving off a high-energy reading... So you figured the power reactor is there?
But a place that important is sure to be guarded by powerful enemies.
Seravee, Cherudim and Arios, the three of them, head for Veda covertly...
You on the Hero Team cut off the power source. And the remaining members...
...take the control rooms of the giant weapons one by one. ...That's the plan, right?
Veda, the power source, the control rooms... I see. Hitting three places at once. Smart thinking.
...So? Should you really be loafing around here?
The Zero System...?
Yeah.
I don't really understand the technical side of things.
But was Epyon one of your comrades?
No, he wasn't. But he's certainly someone who could become a comrade.
He had something in common with us, and yet he ended up serving the enemy.
I don't know what happened to him, but if he's an enemy, there's no choice but to destroy him.
So the high-energy reading was the Devil Gundam.
...But you beat it, right?
...We did beat it, but we didn't confirm it was wiped out.
It's still alive?
Can't say. But the DG Cells have the power to regenerate themselves.
Then we can't rest easy.
Zamsha became the Devil Gundam's Life Core!?
Yes, it surprised me. To think someone with his strength of will could be absorbed...
So what happened to Zamsha after that?
He vanished somewhere, but I don't know where he went.
...I see. He may come to challenge you again someday.
I heard the Gundam Team is having a hard time!? I'm worried...
What are you doing? Go rescue them at once!! You're the only ones who can move right now!!
I see... So Epyon had been swallowed by the Zero System.
The enemy makes every kind of "power" its own... I wonder what it's after in the end...
So you couldn't stop the Libra Cannon from the control room...
No. But we did confirm who this Cube's boss is.
Reborns Gundam... that's its name, right? Gundams fighting each other, though...
He... Someone like him could never be a Gundam...!!
Epyon sacrificed himself to destroy the reactor core for us?
Do you think he meant it as atonement?
The truth is unknown. But in the end, he regained his "heart."
That alone gave that battle meaning.
So you're finally going to stop the Colony Laser. The enemy's resistance will be fierce, too.
Make sure you're well prepared before you go.
...By the way, I wonder how Seravee and the others are doing.
They're heading for Veda covertly, right? I hope it's going smoothly...
I heard!! Seravee and the others are in danger!!
If you go after Gaddess now, you should be able to reach Reborns.
Hurry!!
So the enemy knew what Seravee's team was up to... I'd rather not think we were set up, but...
The odds are against us. We'll have to rely on your strength to break through this.
...I heard his voice. Did Seravee... die...!?
Oh, what I was afraid of has come true.
But don't let his resolve go to waste. You must not let Reborns get away, no matter what!
That's right. Seravee risked his life to take back Veda for us.
Isn't it our turn to risk our lives now?
The Gundams are recovering in the medical room. Don't worry, their lives aren't in danger.
With the Capture Cube destroyed, the base's defenses are thin.
If the enemy launches another attack on the base, strike them first.
Be careful. The revived monsters seem to have been powered up.
It looks like Belial brought the monsters back to life.
Make sure you're well prepared before you go.
The "Ultimate Being," huh... That has a very dangerous smell to it.
All we know right now is that the "Ultimate Being" won't be anything good for us.
Right. We have to get our hands on it first.
So Birdon was revived, too.
Birdon is the monster that once defeated Zoffy and Taro.
Impressive. Keep pressing on like that.
So the Devil Gundam was still alive.
If we don't deal with it soon, things will get bad. Shouldn't you hurry on ahead?
Don't let what the enemy says confuse you! There's no way you have negative emotions!

notes.note: SPEAKERS from tools/talkspk.py Shop (Talk01_45-62); slice labels were all missing. Hikari = #0.495/497/510/511/513/515/517/526-530/558/561/563/571/624/625/635/636/644/645/663/665/674-676/685/686; Mebius = #0.496/559/562; Zero = #0.512/514/516; Wing Zero = #0.538/541/543/601/602; 00 = #0.586/588; W (Philip) = #0.664; Methuss = her script-labelled rows. #0.495 continues Hikari's #0.494 ('if we take a direct hit of the same power...'), cut at the same point.
Unlabelled #0.506-508, #0.524/525, #0.552/553/555/557, #0.621-623 assigned to Methuss (shop NPC, feminine speech, her solo talk blocks).
Methuss, unlabelled; reacting to the plan Hikari spells out in #0.526-529. 'Douryokuro' = power reactor; 'douryokugen' = power source as in the story (#0.527/529).
'Kyodai heiki' = 'giant weapons' and hiiroo butai = 'Hero Team', matching the story slices.
Wing Zero (Heero). 'Doushi' = comrade; Epyon g=m.
Unlabelled #0.554/556 assigned to God Gundam (rough 'wakaran na', knows DG Cells, the team that fought the Devil Gundam). Inferred; could be another party member. Subject 'we' restored.
'Jiko saisei nouryoku' = 'the power to regenerate themselves' (the glossary set phrase Self-Regeneration is for the triple slogan).
Mebius per script, though his wording here and at #0.562 is plain rather than his usual polite tone with Hikari; kept earnest and neutral. Label not independently verifiable.
'I don't know' restores the subject; the source is subjectless (could be 'we').
Listener 'you' = Mebius, whom Zamsha dueled before; 'shoubu wo idomu' = challenge.
00 answers Methuss's negative statement ('you couldn't stop it') with 'aa' = confirms it; English 'No.' agrees with the negative.
00, echoing his story line against Reborns ('Something like you could never be a Gundam!!'). Reborns g=m.
Quote marks around 'heart' kept as in the source.
'Koe wo kiita' read as heard his voice (Seravee's Voice through Veda in the story); could also mean 'heard the news'. Inferred.
Methuss per script; 'aa' read as a sigh ('Oh'), not agreement.
Unlabelled; assigned to Hikari (masculine commanding 'ki wo tsukero', paired with Methuss in Talk01_58).
Same Japanese as #0.611 apart from a comma; same English.
Source has a mis-typed kanji for 'nioi' (smell); read as 'smell'. 'Ultimate Being' per glossary.
Passive 'Zoffy and Taro were once defeated by Birdon' made active.
Methuss per script; 'aite no kaiwa' = what the enemy says. 'Negative emotions' as in the story (Minus Energy context).

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers from tools/talkspk.py Shop; unlabelled rows assigned: Methuss (#0.506-508/524/525/552/553/555/557/621-623), God Gundam (#0.554/556, inferred), Hikari (#0.653). Uncertain: #0.559/562 Mebius label vs plain tone; #0.632 'heard his voice' reading; #0.554/556 speaker. No new glossary names; Capture Cube, particle cannon, giant weapons, Hero Team, power reactor follow story slices.
